privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: JobLens is a small, invite-only service. This page says what it keeps about you, where that goes, for how long, and how you take it with you or delete it.
privacy.who.title: Who is responsible
privacy.who.text: {operator} runs JobLens and decides what happens with your data. For questions or requests: {contact}.
privacy.what.title: What JobLens keeps
privacy.what.account: Your account: your e-mail address, the name and language you chose, and whether you are a tester. Login links and sign-ins are stored only as fingerprints, never as they are.
privacy.what.cv: Your CV: the file you upload is kept for 30 days, then deleted. What stays is its text with your contact details taken out (e-mail, phone, address, postcode, date of birth, links and ID numbers, and your name if you give it), and what a model read from it.
privacy.what.answers: What you are looking for: your answers, exactly as you gave them.
privacy.what.matches: Your matches and marks: which vacancies were compared with your CV, what the model said about them, and every mark with the reason you typed.
privacy.what.usage: Usage: which paid model calls you caused and what they cost, so that a free allowance can be kept.
privacy.what.key: Your own API key, if you add one: stored encrypted, never shown again and never in a download.
privacy.where.title: Where it goes
privacy.where.model: To read your CV and judge vacancies, its text, without your contact details, is sent to an AI model: Google's Gemini, on a paid account, which Google does not use to improve its products. If you add your own key, reading and judging go to the provider you chose; turning your CV into a search vector always uses Gemini, so that it can be compared with the vacancies.
privacy.where.storage: Everything is stored in a database at Neon in Frankfurt (EU), and JobLens runs on Google Cloud in the Netherlands.
privacy.where.nothing: No advertising, no analytics, no trackers. JobLens sets one cookie, to keep you signed in, and loads its fonts and scripts from itself.
privacy.long.title: How long
privacy.long.text: The uploaded file: 30 days. A login link: 7 days. A sign-in: 30 days. Everything else: until you delete your account.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.text: In Settings you can download everything JobLens keeps about you as one file, and delete your account with everything in it, at once. For anything else, write to {contact}. You can also complain to the Dutch data protection authority, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
privacy.why.title: Why
privacy.why.text: JobLens uses your data only to give you what you asked for: comparing your CV with vacancies (GDPR, article 6(1)(b)).
admin.nightlyHint: When on, JobLens fetches new vacancies from every source, Indeed included, at the times below, and makes them searchable. When off, nothing is fetched by itself and the vacancies already there stay; Fetch now still works. A run that has started finishes either way.

admin.title: Admin
admin.intro: For you, the owner: where the vacancies come from, what each nightly update did, and who has an account.
admin.sourcesHint: Stored is everything a source ever gave JobLens, open is what is still advertised, and in JobLens is what a match ranks: open, read by the model, and not a copy of a job from another source. Listed and new come from the last fetch that asked the source. Open a source to see its boards or searches.
admin.sourcesNone: No nightly run has reported on the sources yet. The next run fills this in.
admin.searchNote: A search has no stored, open or in-JobLens count of its own: a vacancy two searches found belongs to neither, so those numbers are for the source as a whole.
admin.runsNone: No run has been recorded yet.
admin.refusingHint: A site that refuses a request is left alone until the time shown, twice as long with each refusal in a row, up to a week. JobLens never goes around a refusal.
admin.refusingNone: No site is refusing JobLens right now.
admin.runHint: Fetch now asks every source now, even while the nightly switch is off, then reads and publishes what is new. It takes a while; this page follows it.
admin.runStopSure: Stop the run that is going? What it fetched so far is not kept.
admin.runStarting: Starting: the run shows up here within a minute or two.
admin.runLocal: Runs are started from the hosted JobLens: this one has no nightly job to start.
admin.runStopping: Stopping the run: Cloud Run ends it within a few seconds.
admin.nextOff: Switched off: nothing runs by itself.
admin.scheduleHint: Dutch time. Two runs a day must be at least 6 hours apart: each asks every site again.
admin.scheduleGap: Two runs a day must be at least 6 hours apart.
admin.spendHint: Every paid model call, by whose key paid. A tester may spend {allowance} a month on JobLens's key, and everything on it together {cap}; an own key has no limit.
admin.spendAll: JobLens's key, everyone: {spent} of {cap}. At the cap, testers without their own key are stopped until next month.
admin.spendYours: Of which your own use: {spent}. It counts towards the cap too.
